about_the_game:
EVERY RACE IS DIFFERENT.

This is Rattus VELOCITAS, an arcade racing game where Rats with Jet-powered hoverbikes compete for pole position in procedurally generated race courses! Collect items to give yourself an advantage or take out the competition in this high speed rodent frenzy!

RACE IN VARIOUS ENVIRONMENTS!

5 different environments are available to race in, all with randomised race course layouts, including Desert, Forest, Space Station, The Volcanic Region and a suspiciously race track shaped beach...

COLLECT ITEMS TO BOOST YOUR SPEED OR TAKE OUT THE COMPETITION!

5 different items are obtainable in-race, including Missiles, Bombs, Cheese, Portable Dash Ring projectors and Shields. There's also a 6th mysterious item... Legends say it reacts explosively to shields.

MULTIPLE WAYS TO PLAY!

To begin with, you'll only have a single mode. However, once onboarded to the Rat Race, you'll unlock more ways to start races, including choosing your desired race environment and CPU racer difficulty or even replaying a previous race course random seed!

FANCY RAT COLOURS AWAIT.

Up to 7 fancy rat colour patterns are selectable to customise your Rat, with additional colour patterns being unlockable with certain milestones!

PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS!

This game can be enjoyed on your own or with up to 4 players on a single PC!
With the introduction of the Online mode update, it is now also possible to play with friends across the internet!
Play Quick Race against randoms or setup your own lobby with friends to race in for the ultimate curated multiplayer experience.*

Wanna join the rat race?

*Please note that multiple game controllers, including Xbox 360, Xbox One, Dualshock 4(R) or DualSense(R) controllers are required for Splitscreen multiplayer mode. Performance depending on your PC's hardware configuration may be reduced in Splitscreen. Online mode requires a Broadband internet connection with 2mbps of upload bandwidth to operate correctly. Mobile networks are not officially supported.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 860 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 640 / AMD Radeon R7 240
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Support for NVIDIA Kepler based graphics cards on Linux ended in September 2024, it is highly recommended to upgrade to a Maxwell architecture graphics card or equivalent AMD graphics card to ensure stability of your Linux gaming system. A broadband internet connection with at least 2mbps of upload bandwidth is required to play the online mode. Mobile networks are not officially supported.
